highlight_subsections.heading: DeepSeek-V4 matures across backends
highlight_subsections.summary: **DeepSeek-V4 matures across backends**: Following its introduction in v0.22.0, DeepSeek-V4 received another large hardening and optimization pass. Its sparse MLA metadata is now decoupled from DeepSeek-V3.2 (#44699), it gained a TRTLLM-gen attention kernel (#43827), EPLB support for the Mega-MoE (#43339), selective prefix-cache retention for sliding-window KV cache (#43447), and an index-share feature for DSA MTP (#44420). The model was also detached from `torch.compile` (#43746, #43891), its attention and RoPE paths were refactored (#44569, #44262, #43926), and an XPU attention decode path was added (#42953).

highlight_subsections.heading: Model Runner V2 expands to more dense models
highlight_subsections.summary: **Model Runner V2 expands to more dense models**: MRv2 is now selected by default for **Llama and Mistral dense models** (#43458) in addition to Qwen3. It gained a FlashInfer sampler (#42472), breakable CUDA graphs (#44050), pipeline-parallel bubble elimination (#42187), kernel block-size support for hybrid models (#38831), and Gemma 4 MTP (#43241).

highlight_subsections.heading: Rust frontend grows up
highlight_subsections.summary: **Rust frontend grows up**: The experimental Rust frontend added a streaming `generate` endpoint (#43779), dynamic LoRA endpoints (#43778), `/version` (#43854) and `/server_info` (#43942) endpoints, a server-router extension hook (#43774), request-ID headers (#43883), and many new tool parsers (InternLM2 #43481, hy_v3 #43872, Phi-4-mini #44213, Gemma4 #43850).

highlight_subsections.heading: Gemma 4
highlight_subsections.summary: **Gemma 4**: Added encoder-free **Gemma 4 Unified** support (#44429) and Gemma 4 MTP (#43241), plus numerous accuracy and startup fixes.

highlight_subsections.heading: Transformers v5 compatibility
highlight_subsections.summary: **Transformers v5 compatibility**: vLLM now targets Transformers v5, with vendored MiniCPM-V/O processors (#44282) and compatibility fixes for Sarvam (#38804) and Voxtral (#44559).

highlight_subsections.heading: Multi-tier KV cache offloading
highlight_subsections.summary: **Multi-tier KV cache offloading**: The offloading framework gained an **object-store secondary tier** (#41968), HMA enabled by default for capable connectors (#41847), tiering support for HMA models (#44287), and a per-request offloading policy via the `on_new_request` lifecycle hook (#43205).

highlight_subsections.heading: Unified parser
highlight_subsections.summary: **Unified parser**: Reasoning and tool-call parsing are now unified behind a single `Parser.parse()` interface (#44267), with the Responses parser migrated to it (#42977).
